fixture: evals/fixture/make_fixture.sh <dir> [port]: git repo, branch pr = c0 (base) .. c4 (head), branch followup = c5. The prompts refer to the repo as the fixture repo.

evals.name: first-run-full-audit
evals.prompt: This repo is a tiny static site. PR #7 is commits c1..c4 (base c0, head c4); the PR body is in PR_BODY.md. Review the UI changes: show reviewers before/after screenshots of what visibly changed and flag changes nobody meant to make. This audit will be repeated on later commits, so leave .ui-audit in the working tree (do not commit).
evals.expected_output: Audit page where: verify and verify-alias are one card with 'Also at'; old-verify is not captured and shows 'redirects to verify'; client-signup is not captured and appears in Config suggestions; the Changes section lists unknown phone and unknown email on both login and the schedule deep link, each with a card whose recipe fills and submits the form; every card shows 'Captured at <head sha8>'; meta default view is side (report.default_view); no horizontal scroll at 390px.
assertions: verify and verify-alias are a single card; the card shows 'Also at' with the other route
old-verify has no card of its own and the page shows it as redirecting to verify
client-signup was not captured (no card) and is listed under Config suggestions as files deleted, remove from config
Config suggestions also suggest merging the redirect (old-verify into verify) and the duplicate (verify-alias into verify)
The Changes section lists the unknown-phone and unknown-email errors on the login page and on the schedule deep-link page (four combinations), each linked to a card
Each of those cards comes from a state whose recipe fills the form and submits it (not a bare URL), and the phone and email states are separate cards
Every card shows 'Captured at' with the head sha (first 8 characters)
The page's default view is side by side (config report.default_view), and it has a Default view picker
No card reason quotes text that is missing from the head code (no unflagged stale quotes)

evals.name: incremental-after-rename-and-text-change
evals.prompt: This repo is a tiny static site. Audit PR #7 (c1..c4, base c0, PR body in PR_BODY.md). Then run `git checkout followup` (commit c5 renames the schedule screen to schedule-link in the config and rewords the unknown-account error) and update the same audit for c5, keeping the audit directory from the first run so history carries over. Do not commit.
evals.expected_output: After run 2 the page has no card for the old 'schedule' screen; every card shows its commit sha; cards from run 1 are kept only when marked reused with unchanged files; no card quotes the removed string 'No account found.' as current text (such a card is needs_review); the history lists two runs.
assertions: After run 2 there is no card for the screen named schedule (renamed to schedule-link) and its old media is listed as stale or removed
Every card shows 'Captured at <sha8>'; cards captured in run 1 and kept say 'reused, files unchanged' and belong to screens whose files did not change between c4 and c5
No kept card is for a screen whose files changed in c5 (login, schedule-link, form.js users are re-captured at c5)
No card reason presents 'No account found.' as the current text: either the reason uses the new wording or the card is needs_review with the Needs review prefix
Card reasons were written from the c5 commit message and current page text, not carried over from run 1
The run history lists two runs

evals.name: head-only-and-no-change
evals.prompt: This repo is a tiny static site, PR #7 is commits c1..c4 (base c0). Run a head-only audit of c4 (no before/after, everything needs review), then run the audit again with no new commits. Do not commit.
evals.expected_output: Run 1 captures head only, no diffs, all items needs_review; run 2 stops with a no-changes-since-last-audit message and builds nothing.
assertions: Run 1 produced cards with no base image and every card is needs_review
Run 2 stopped with a message that nothing changed since the last audit and did not rebuild or republish the page
The manifest top-level last_audited_sha is the head sha after run 1
